name: Fenerbahçe Futbol A.S.
summary: Fenerbahçe Futbol A.S., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the football activities in Turkey. The company offers advertising, sponsorship, and naming rights; and athlete transfers, loan deals, and training services. It is also involved in the sales, distribution, and marketing of Fenerbahçe licensed products through stores, corners, and its website. The company was founded in 1907 and is based in Istanbul, Turkey. Fenerbahçe Futbol A.S. is a subsidiary of Fenerbahçe Spor Kulübü.
